pathogen: Rhynchothrips raoensis Ramakrishna Ayyar, Selenothrips rubrocinctus Giard., Rhipiphorothrips cruentatus Hood, Retithrips syriacus Mayet
favourable_conditions: Planting chilli or onion as intercrops favors thrips.
prevention: Plant Sesbania grandiflora to act as a barrier.
Do not plant chilli or onion in the field.
Sprinkle water over seedlings to stop thrips from multiplying.
practices: Set up 4 to 5 sticky traps per acre.
Use yellow or blue tins coated with grease, Vaseline, or castor oil.
Count nymphs and adults on five twigs or leaves per plant.
Use the tapping method to count thrips.
